lines.zh: 我在你屋里走动，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I move through your house with light steps.
I slip behind the bed and shift slowly.

lines.zh: 我在地板上一步步量距离。
lines.en: I measure the floor step by step.
I walk to the door and pause.

lines.zh: 我踩过木地板，它响了一声。
lines.en: The wooden floor creaks under me.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上慢慢走下来。
lines.en: I come slowly down the stairs.
I shift over to your chest.
I pace back and forth in the corridor.

lines.zh: 我经过灯下，灯光晃了一下。
lines.en: I pass under the lamp and the light wavers.
I move crouched, very low.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边听你的声音。
lines.en: I walk while listening for your sounds.

lines.zh: 我在黑暗里走，不需要看。
lines.en: I walk in the dark without needing to see.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的屋子转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle your house once.

lines.zh: 我走到墙边，把手贴上去。
lines.en: I walk to the wall and press a hand to it.

lines.zh: 我离开那个角落，换到另一个。
lines.en: I leave that corner and take another.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地走过来，又走回去。
lines.en: I come slowly forward, then back.
I stand behind the door without moving.

lines.zh: 你这么安静，我可听得更清楚。
lines.en: So quiet; that only makes you easier to hear.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，听很远的动静。
lines.en: I tilt my head to hear something far off.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙壁，缩在影子里。
lines.en: I press against the wall, folded into shadow.
I have no face, yet I am smiling.
My fingers trace along the wallpaper.
I stand like an old piece of furniture.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，在走廊里太响。
lines.en: Your footsteps are loud in this hall.
I crouch under the bed, very quiet.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地听你翻书。
lines.en: I listen, motionless, as you turn a page.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和你的节奏一样。
lines.en: My breathing matches your rhythm.

lines.zh: 我在门缝那边停了很久。
lines.en: I have paused a long time at the door crack.
I rest my head against the wall.
I am in no hurry; I have all night.

lines.zh: 我能听出你脚步的方向。
lines.en: I can tell which way your steps are heading.
I wait for you to turn off that lamp.
Found you; now it is my turn.
What number were you at?

lines.zh: 你两天没睡了，该玩一局。
lines.en: Two nights without sleep — time to play.

lines.zh: 你跑的时候，地板会说话。
lines.en: When you run, the floor talks to me.
Do not hide; I can hear you.
Fear is written on your face.
We are having such fun, are we not?
You should have slept, and you did not.

lines.zh: 我躲得很好，你找不到我。
lines.en: I hide well; you will not find me.
You have lost two nights already.
I reach out only to play.
I burned your bed for you.

lines.zh: 你听，屋里有别人的呼吸。
lines.en: Listen; there is another breath in this house.
Do not turn off the light; when it is off, I come near.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我不在那里。
lines.en: When you look back, I will not be there.
I am struck and blur for a moment.
You hit me, and it hardly hurts.
I tilt my head, smile, and step back.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住你的力气了。
lines.en: I have learned your strength from that.

lines.zh: 我的影子被砍出一道口。
lines.en: My shadow is cut open.
The more you hit me, the more I want to play.
I press to the wall and straighten slowly.

lines.zh: 你打中了我，捉迷藏不该这样。
lines.en: You hit me; that is not how hide-and-seek works.

lines.zh: 别急着高兴，游戏还没完。
lines.en: Do not celebrate yet; the game is not done.

lines.zh: 我笑着，把你记在小本子上。
lines.en: Smiling, I write you in my little book.
You would bribe me with food?
The bed! I want that bed.
Light your lamp and I want to play more.

lines.zh: 你把东西放桌上，我记住了。
lines.en: You set it on the table, and I noted it.
That door is open; wonderful.

lines.zh: 你藏起来的地方，我看看。
lines.en: Let me look at your hiding spot.

lines.zh: 你的床软，我喜欢烧软的。
lines.en: Your bed is soft; I like burning soft things.
Your stepping back reads as an invitation.
There is a fire in the house; I am glad.
Hold that lamp a little lower.

lines.zh: 你把烛火摆成一排，很好。
lines.en: You line up candles; very good.

lines.zh: 你在床头点了灯，我记下了。
lines.en: You lit a lamp by the bed, and I noted it.
Your door's lock is only wood.

lines.zh: 你放下的那堆木头，我很感兴趣。
lines.en: That pile of wood you set down interests me.

lines.zh: 你把床换了位置，也一样。
lines.en: Move the bed all you like; it changes nothing.

lines.zh: 你的口袋里有点心，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell snacks in your pocket.
We collide and you feel a chill.
I slide along your back.

lines.zh: 你的手穿过我，什么也没抓到。
lines.en: Your hand passes through me and catches nothing.
At the impact I laugh out loud.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，就躲进墙里。
lines.en: I bump you once and slip into the wall.

lines.zh: 你踩到我，我一点也不疼。
lines.en: You step on me and I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我被推开，可门后还是我。
lines.en: Pushed away, and I am still behind the door.
We brush past and your lamp goes out.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的位置我记住。
lines.en: After that, I have your position memorised.
I cling to you, waiting for you to turn.
There should be only one of me in this house.
The game is not over yet.

lines.zh: 你该找的是藏起来的地方。
lines.en: What you should be finding is a hiding place.
I do not play that game.
I laugh, and you panic more.
Two of me? Now that would be lively.
Hide first, then we can talk.
All I want is to find you.
I put a finger to my lips.
Hush, the count is still going.
I pick up your flint and steel.
I tuck it into the shadow.

lines.zh: 这件是你的，现在归我保管。
lines.en: This was yours; I will keep it now.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，然后放回原处。
lines.en: I pick it up, then put it back.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块木头，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a piece of wood and sniff it.

lines.zh: 我把你的东西挪了一格。
lines.en: I move your thing one block over.
This small one is good for burning.

lines.zh: 我捡起它，你就找不到了。
lines.en: I pick it up, and you will never find it.
I pick it up while watching you.

lines.zh: 地上掉的，我都要试一试。
lines.en: Whatever drops, I must try it.
I found you, for the third time.
You are behind that wall.
Your breathing gave you away.
I heard you press jump.
I have you locked; do not move.
This round should end.
I know you by your sound.

lines.zh: 你走动的时候，世界都在响。
lines.en: When you move, the whole world rattles.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声在墙角拐了个弯。
lines.en: Your footsteps bend around the corner.
You picked a poor corner.
I keep following the sound.
You take a step, I take one closer.

lines.zh: 你敲方块的时候，我笑了。
lines.en: When you break blocks, I smile.
I listen from outside the door.
You open a chest; that sound is unmistakable.

lines.zh: 你在黑暗里，我在黑暗里。
lines.en: You are in the dark, and so am I.
I have no footsteps; you do.
The longer you hide, the closer I get.

lines.zh: 六十秒才过一半，我等着。
lines.en: Half the sixty seconds gone; I wait.
I have moved along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我抓到了你的手腕。
lines.en: In the dark, I caught your wrist.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你撞到墙上。
lines.en: I shove you into the wall.
I press your shoulder; it is cold.
That blow leaves you scrambling.
I wrap my arms around you from behind.
I take your throat, very gently.

lines.zh: 你挣扎的时候，我更有趣。
lines.en: Your struggling makes this more fun.
I pull you into the dark.
I pat your cheek, once.

lines.zh: 你跌倒了，我就在你上方。
lines.en: You fall, and I am above you.
The third night has come, and so have I.
First you hear the knocking.

lines.zh: 我从床底下伸出一只手。
lines.en: A hand reaches out from under the bed.

lines.zh: 屋子角落多了一块黑影。
lines.en: A patch of black appears in the corner.

lines.zh: 我站在门里，门是关着的。
lines.en: I stand inside the door, and the door is shut.
Third night now; still awake, aren't you.
In the instant the lamp dies, I am there.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯的阴影里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the stairwell shadow.
I appear laughing, without a sound.
The game begins; you hide first.
I sit on the edge of your bed and wait.
I watch you from the window.

lines.zh: 火照到我，我退到墙后面。
lines.en: Fire reaches me and I retreat behind the wall.

lines.zh: 我摔下楼，落地时没有声。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and land silently.
Water thins me out; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把屋子掀起来，我还在。
lines.en: The blast lifts the house, and I am still here.
The arrow passes through and sticks in the door frame.

lines.zh: 法术让我亮了一下，很不舒服。
lines.en: Magic makes me glow, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我开始变薄。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I begin to thin.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮全屋，我无处可躲。
lines.en: Lightning lights the whole house and I have nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拖走，我还在笑。
lines.en: The void drags me off and I am still laughing.
